g.text: Repair the statement with a precondition
WORKED PROOF · EXCLUDE THE BOTTOM LETTER

Theorem lower_letter_lowers : forall l : letter, letter_comparison F l = Lt -> letter_comparison (lower_letter l) l = Lt.Proof. intros l H. destruct l. - reflexivity. (* A *) - reflexivity. (* B *) - reflexivity. (* C *) - reflexivity. (* D *) - simpl in H. simpl. rewrite H. reflexivity.Qed.
The hypothesis says F is strictly below l.For l = F it becomes Eq = Lt, an impossible assumption.For the four other letters, the conclusion computes directly.
